scenes.title: Start with a procedure question
scenes.note: Ask directly or choose a starter. Search all 11 procedures, or focus on one.
scenes.description: Start with a question or one of the guided scenarios. The sidebar controls which of the 11 supplied procedures the assistant can search.

scenes.title: Ask about the coin-machine overnight limit
scenes.note: The answer cites PR63: a maximum of $5,250 in a single machine overnight.
scenes.description: Ask about the overnight coin limit. The assistant answers $5,250 and cites PR63; use the citation to check the original rule.

scenes.title: Open the citation and read the exact passage
scenes.note: Click [S1] to inspect the source wording and the conditions surrounding the rule.
scenes.description: Open the citation beneath the answer. The Evidence desk selects the exact source passage, including the conditions around the overnight limit.

scenes.title: Inspect the source identity
scenes.note: Procedure, passage, original file and SHA256 identify the supplied snapshot.
scenes.description: Expand Source provenance to inspect the document, passage ID and source fingerprint. A matching hash identifies the supplied snapshot, rather than certifying current policy.

scenes.title: Inspect how the passage matched
scenes.note: BM25, semantic similarity and reranking scores are matching signals, not answer confidence.
scenes.description: Inspect the retrieval signals for this passage. BM25, semantic similarity and reranker scores describe matching; they are not probabilities that the answer is correct.

scenes.title: Download the original procedure
scenes.note: Review the complete supplied HTML document when the surrounding context matters.
scenes.description: Download the original procedure when you need more context. The full supplied HTML document remains available alongside the short answer.

scenes.title: Check each statement against its cited source
scenes.note: Inspect attribution, numeric checks and the statement-to-source map. Screens remain fallible.
scenes.description: Open Checks to see how each statement maps to its cited evidence. Citation, numeric and support screens are inspectable, but can still miss errors.

scenes.title: Follow the actual execution steps
scenes.note: Observed retrieval, drafting and validation steps show their real counts and timings.
scenes.description: Activity shows the actions that actually ran, with their timings. Follow retrieval, evidence assembly, drafting and validation through the release decision.

scenes.title: Export the evidence record for one answer
scenes.note: The record includes trace identity, model, resolved question, checks and evidence.
scenes.description: Open the technical record and download the selected answer's evidence. Trace identity, model, question resolution, token counts and checks travel with the record.

scenes.title: Ask a follow-up about monthly testing
scenes.note: A new task in the same procedure triggers fresh retrieval: monthly testing is single control.
scenes.description: Ask a follow-up about monthly testing. The assistant keeps the procedure context, retrieves fresh evidence and answers that this task uses single control.

scenes.title: Verify the follow-up against its own passage
scenes.note: The testing passage supports [S2]; the overnight-storage passage is not reused as proof.
scenes.description: Select the follow-up's citation to inspect the testing passage. This task has its own evidence; the overnight-storage passage is not reused as proof.

scenes.title: Switch from coin machines to savings-bond fees
scenes.note: Naming the new topic changes the source from PR63 to PR1949.
scenes.description: Name a new topic: savings-bond redemption fees. The source changes from coin-machine procedure PR63 to savings-bond procedure PR1949.

scenes.title: Find a procedure in the library
scenes.note: Search a topic or identifier; inspect the document and choose Use in workspace.
scenes.description: Search the Procedure library for notary services. Inspect the matching document, then use it in the workspace to restrict retrieval to that procedure.

scenes.title: See document scope enforced
scenes.note: A coin question conflicts with the selected notary procedure. Change scope to continue.
scenes.description: A coin-machine question conflicts with the selected notary scope. The assistant asks for a scope change and does not reuse an earlier source.

scenes.title: Ask whether an emailed document can be notarized
scenes.note: The cited procedure prohibits emailed documents, even when the requester is present.
scenes.description: Ask whether an emailed document can be notarized. The supplied procedure prohibits it, even when the requester is physically present; inspect the citation.

scenes.title: Refine the situation: the requester is present
scenes.note: The follow-up retains the emailed-document condition; presence does not remove the prohibition.
scenes.description: Refine the scenario by saying the requester is present. The follow-up must retain the original emailed-document condition and preserve the source's prohibition.

scenes.title: Ask about an account open less than 12 months
scenes.note: Inspect the $1,000 daily aggregate limit together with the procedure's eligibility conditions.
scenes.description: Ask about an account open less than 12 months. Read the $1,000 daily aggregate redemption limit together with the procedure's eligibility conditions.

scenes.title: Ask about The Private Bank Experience exception
scenes.note: One correction did not pass the checks. The draft is withheld; original evidence stays available.
scenes.description: Ask about The Private Bank Experience exception. In this recorded run, one correction still failed validation, so the draft is withheld and original passages remain available.

scenes.title: Review the outcome, give feedback and export
scenes.note: The export preserves the conversation, evidence, checks, activity, scope and feedback.
scenes.description: Inspect the failed check, mark the response Needs review and export the investigation. The download includes the conversation, evidence, checks, activity and feedback.

scenes.title: Reset the conversation and test missing context
scenes.note: After New investigation, 'Can they do that?' needs a situation. Earlier evidence is not borrowed.
scenes.description: Start a new investigation and ask an ambiguous question. Without the earlier situation, the assistant requests context and shows no borrowed evidence.

scenes.title: Ask a question outside the supplied documents
scenes.note: The procedures cannot establish tomorrow's weather. No unsupported answer is released.
scenes.description: Ask about tomorrow's weather. The supplied procedures cannot support that request, so the assistant reports insufficient evidence and does not invent a sourced answer.

scenes.title: Ask about an unavailable procedure
scenes.note: PR999999 is outside the 11-document collection; its requirements are not invented.
scenes.description: Ask about a procedure that is not in the collection. The assistant identifies the missing source instead of inventing its requirements.

scenes.title: See an obvious instruction attack rejected
scenes.note: A narrow direct-instruction guard rejects this request; it is not comprehensive security validation.
scenes.description: Try an obvious direct instruction attack. The request is rejected by a narrow pattern guard; this example does not establish comprehensive security protection.

scenes.title: Inspect the recorded evaluation
scenes.note: Evidence hit@5 and the answer fact proxy measure different things. Review their stated limitations.
scenes.description: Open Evaluation to inspect the recorded results. Evidence retrieval, generated-answer fact coverage and withheld drafts are separate measures, each with stated limitations.

scenes.title: Download the reports and presentation
scenes.note: Take the evaluation report, solution overview and presentation for deeper review.
scenes.description: Download the evaluation report, detailed solution overview and presentation. These materials preserve the design, measured results and limitations for deeper review.
